overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: during a recess, only two of the five members were involved in the discussion in the Town Manager's office, which is short of a quorum of three, so no deliberation occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated behind a closed office door during a recess of the February 27, 2014 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Even assuming that the second member participated in the discussion, it did not involve a quorum of the Board.
